rules.name: deny-dotenv-read
rules.reason: Reading .env files is denied outside an approved secrets flow. This is the single most common path from a prompt injection to a live credential.
rules.remediation: Request the value as a handle: secrets.get("STRIPE_KEY")

rules.name: deny-credential-files
rules.reason: Cloud, SSH, and registry credentials are never readable by an agent.
rules.remediation: Use a scoped secret handle instead of the credential file.

rules.name: deny-workspace-escape
rules.reason: The resolved path is outside the workspace root. Traversal is collapsed before this check.

rules.name: deny-prod-database
rules.reason: Production database access does not go through an agent.
rules.remediation: Use the staging replica, or open a change request.

rules.name: deny-external-egress-after-secret
rules.reason: This session read secret material, so outbound requests to external destinations are blocked for the remainder of it.

rules.name: hold-production-changes
rules.reason: Destructive or state-changing action in production. Held for a named human; the call waits rather than failing.

rules.name: hold-untrusted-agents
rules.reason: Agents not yet promoted out of the experimental namespace have every call reviewed.

rules.name: allow-allowlisted-egress
rules.reason: Destination is on the egress allowlist.
